purpose: Verify bus watchdog reaction, fault logging, and recovery path when process-data exchange is interrupted.
preconditions: Axis can reach Operation Enabled in the selected backend.
Fault reset command has been tested without motion.
For hardware runs, a safe low-energy motion profile is selected before any cable-disconnect test.

bench_extension.operator_action: Use a controlled cable-disconnect or interface-down action only after confirming torque limits, travel limits, and stop path.

operator_notes: The simulated version proves software reaction and evidence capture.
A future physical cable-pull run must be labeled separately from the simulated run.
